frame.convention: Hesai lidar frame: z = rotation axis (up); y = 0° azimuth (connector side); x completes a right-handed frame
frame.origin: On the rotation axis, 46.4 mm above the bottom face (red dot, Fig. 4/5). Optical centres are 13 mm either side of it.

sources.what: Coordinate system: z rotation axis, y = 0° azimuth
Origin 46.4 mm above base, optical centre offsets 13 mm, channel elevations +19.5° … -20.8°
Specifications: range 0.5–300 m, HFOV 360°, VFOV 40.3° (-20.8° to +19.5°), H 75 mm, Ø89/Ø93 mm
Exterior dimensions: base Ø93 x 24.4 mm, head Ø89, total 75 mm
